body.description: Actual isolated_stdio_v1 qualification proved the installed Docker CLI returns exact lowercase error: no such object; strict parsing only recognized capitalized forms. The source now accepts this exact additional form and still refuses transport/changed-daemon ambiguity. Initial real cat execution timed out and original inspect/rm briefly blocked despite healthy daemon info. CORRECTION to initial diagnosis: delayed inspection of that original showed StdinOnce=true and all Attach fields true already, so omission of explicit CLI attach flags is not established as its timeout cause. Explicit flags plus actual stream-contract checks now harden the source, and subsequent real terminal, lost-create/lost-terminal ACK and first-seal recovery cases passed. Original hang cause remains unknown; exact owned allocation cleanup was later confirmed and all late-created test intents reconciled with zero final finite allocations. Estimated time lost 180 seconds.
